canonical_identity.title: Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, Agriculture, and Legislative Branch Appropriations Act, 2026

plain_language_description: At the House-passage stage, an FY2026 funding bill for military construction, military housing, veterans benefits and health care, and related agencies; the Senate later expanded it and the bill remained in conference rather than becoming law itself.
prior_policy_baseline: Congress had not enacted the relevant FY2026 regular funding bill. The House vote advanced one chamber's proposed funding and policy terms.
proposed_action_or_mechanism: Provide annual discretionary funding and policy conditions across military construction and family housing, the Department of Veterans Affairs, and related agencies.
directly_affected: Related agencies named in the bill

material_scale.note: The amount is retained in the dossier verification layer, not the top-card copy.

implementation_authority: Department of Defense, Department of Veterans Affairs, and related funded agencies, subject to enacted appropriations.
legislative_history: The House passed its version June 25. The Senate passed an expanded version. The House requested a conference in September. H.R. 3944 itself did not become law; related full-year areas were later enacted in a different package, H.R. 5371.

documented_supporter_rationale.summary: The committee majority described its recommendation as funding military infrastructure and veterans services while attaching oversight and policy conditions.

documented_opponent_rationale.note: No single opposition rationale is attributed to Foushee or presented as explaining all Nays.

important_uncertainties: The House-passed text included floor amendments; top-layer copy avoids unsupported line-item precision.
Later H.R. 5371 funding cannot be substituted for the exact policy content of roll 182.
Roll 180 is a mixed en-bloc amendment and remains a separate control.
